notes: this is a second chain with no saying of its own: the variants «وفي حديث ابن جعفر قال فرسا لنا» and «وفي حديث خالد عن قتادة سمعت أنسا» follow and are not routes
«- يعني ابن الحارث -» is an editor gloss and is left out
«بهذا الإسناد» points back to the first head, so routes 1 and 2 are read as continuing through شعبة, which the text does not write for them; no link is added for that
